notes.title: FEVER: Fight The FEVER - DEMO RELEASED!
notes.content:
[h3][i]Unsure if [b]FEVER: Fight The FEVER[/b] is the game for you?[/i][/h3] 
Well, you're in luck! Our [b]FEVER DEMO[/b] will give you the opportunity to try the entire first level, complete with first boss encounter (The Inexplicable "[b]BLOBBY[/b]"); then you will be thrust into endless mode to continue battling [b]GERMS[/b] to your heart's content.

Not enough for you??? The full version of [b]FEVER: Fight The FEVER[/b] boasts more bosses, levels, and enemies with different challenges to uproot your strategy.

[h2]Tired of YOUR biology course? TRY OURS!!![/h2]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1418610/FEVER_FIGHT_THE_FEVER/

notes.title: FEVER: Fight The FEVER - 40% OFF Launch Sale!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=X4sVw9d4-zo;full][/previewyoutube]
[h2]We here at Zin Games LLC are proud to announce that FEVER: Fight The FEVER has finally been released on STEAM! [/h2]

After the long and grueling process of getting our first game ready and released, we have finally accomplished our initial goal. We are so excited we are offering a one-week launch discount for our customers who want to get ahead of the crowd and help spread the word.

FEVER is an old-school arcade style game that mixes classic gaming elements with more modern mechanics, plus a dash of chaos and a whole heap of unique innovations. [b]Sick of the same'ol healthbars? [/b]Just wait until you see what we did with ours!
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=X4sVw9d4-zo
But it doesn't stop there. We have plenty of plans for future updates so keep an eye out! 

[h3]~Zincerely,
Zinlanthor[/h3]
